title: Skill Preflight ten-repository benchmark and conservative finding triage
method: Convenience sample, not representative of all GitHub skills. Full snapshots on Linux; 278 discovered SKILL.md files. No upstream scripts executed. Identical commits and skill counts verified between phases. Each finding receives a triage label; conditional/unconfirmed labels are not validated upstream bugs. No customer adoption or willingness to pay inferred.
